This is the whole economic argument for the comparison article, and it is a verified statement, not marketing. (4) OFFICIAL CHANNEL = MIDASBUY. Midasbuy is Delta Force's official top-up center and DOES have an Uzbekistan-localised path (midasbuy.com/midasbuy/uz/shop/dfm exists and is indexed). SEAGM explicitly shows no nickname/account confirmation before payment; topuplive's own FAQ says a wrong ID 'may cause delay/failure or wrong delivery — contact customer service immediately'; JollyMax's flow requires a support ticket if coins went to a non-existent account. GemPay's FREE pre-payment nickname check is therefore a genuine, differentiating claim for this game. (7) GLOBAL vs GARENA IS THE REAL FAILURE MODE — bigger here than in most games.
